problem: The required PR evidence workflow can execute validator and adversarial-test code from the same candidate PR it is judging, and milestone human approval is not machine-bound to GitHub review provenance.

decision.rationale: Keep candidate code non-authoritative by running policy from the base/default branch, add an additive trust-boundary validator, and bind human gates to exact-head GitHub review provenance.

official_docs.verified_constraint: pull_request_target runs in the context of the base/default branch; candidate code must not be executed with privileged credentials.
Strict required status checks are needed to require a branch to be up to date before merge.

alternatives.reason: A PR can weaken the validator/tests that judge the same PR.
Previous trusted policy remains authoritative while candidate files are treated only as data.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Required evidence validation executes policy from the PR base/default branch rather than the candidate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: pr-evidence-trusted.yml uses pull_request_target and separate trusted/candidate checkouts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Adversarial tests cover human exact-head review, data/script classification, product identity and blank official-doc N/A.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: GitHub Actions run 33184528114 completed successfully; its adversarial evidence-policy test step passed on the candidate branch.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Governance-critical changes become diff-detected and require a same-PR governance manifest.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/check_trust_boundary.py governance path policy and scripts/policy_tests/test_trust_boundary.py adversarial cases.

automated: GitHub Actions run 33184528114: validate-pr-evidence SUCCESS; adversarial evidence-policy tests, structural validator and diff policy all passed.
manual: Reviewed pull_request_target security boundary and current Protect main ruleset state.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Required evidence policy moves from candidate-controlled execution to base/default-branch trusted execution. Candidate HEAD is checked out only for inspection.
governance.bypass_analysis: Covers validator/test self-modification, governance-file downgrade, stale/non-exact human approvals, same-author/bot approvals, same-product multi-URL reference padding, ambiguous data paths and blank official-doc N/A parsing.
governance.rollback: Revert this PR to restore the prior pull_request workflow and remove the additive trust-boundary layer.

known_limitations: Repository ruleset strict/up-to-date enforcement remains a GitHub settings action and is tracked in issue #4.
The bootstrap PR is judged by the previous policy; exact-head governance approval becomes mandatory after this change is present in main.
The temporary bootstrap pull_request workflow must be removed immediately after merge under the new trusted workflow.
